content.comment_body: I want to connect a stepper driver to [product_name] using its Ethernet port. Can the Ethernet port be used to communicate with external hardware from other manufacturers?
If the stepper driver supports Ethernet and modbus/tcp, it can communicate with [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about the ability of the Ethernet port on [product_name] to interface with external devices such as stepper drivers. The main finding is a lack of clear information about its compatibility and supported communication protocols (particularly modbus/tcp). Users want to improve integration but are uncertain about the Ethernet port's capabilities and protocol support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the Ethernet port on [product_name] can be configured or used to send signals to external hardware, making use of standard protocols like modbus/tcp.
